beacon-popover-title:
Heading at the top of the notifications popover that opens from the bell.
{{Identical|Notifications}}
beacon-popover-empty: Shown in the notifications popover when the user has no notifications.
beacon-popover-mark-read:
Tooltip and accessible label of the dot button on an unread notification in the notifications popover, which marks it as read.
{{Identical|Mark as read}}
beacon-popover-mark-unread:
Tooltip and accessible label of the ring button on a read notification in the notifications popover, which marks it as unread again.
{{Identical|Mark as unread}}
beacon-popover-mark-all-read:
Label of the button at the top of the notifications popover that marks every notification as read.
{{Identical|Mark all as read}}
beacon-popover-error: Shown in the notifications popover when loading the notifications failed.
beacon-popover-retry:
Label of the button that tries loading the notifications again after it failed.
{{Identical|Try again}}
beacon-popover-action-error: Shown in a pop-up message when marking notifications as read or unread failed.
beacon-popover-all:
Label of the button at the bottom of the notifications popover that goes to [[Special:Notifications]].
{{Identical|All notifications}}
beacon-popover-preferences: Accessible label and tooltip of the icon-only button at the bottom of the notifications popover that goes to the notification preferences.
beacon-badge-count-max:
Shown in the notifications badge instead of the count when the user has more unread notifications than are counted.

Parameters:
* $1 - the most notifications that are counted (99)
beacon-notifications-badge:
Text of the notifications badge in the user links, shown next to the bell icon or instead of it in skins without icons.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of unread notifications
beacon-notification-reverted-undo:
Header of the notification sent when someone reverts the recipient's edit. Plain text, rendered when the notification is created.

Parameters:
* $1 - username of the user who undid the edit, also usable for GENDER
* $2 - title of the page
beacon-notification-reverted-rollback:
Header of the notification sent when someone rolls back the recipient's edit. Plain text, rendered when the notification is created.

Parameters:
* $1 - username of the user who rolled back the edit, also usable for GENDER
* $2 - title of the page
beacon-notification-edited-user-js:
Header of the notification sent when someone else edits one of the recipient's personal JavaScript pages (User:Name/*.js). Plain text, rendered when the notification is created.

Parameters:
* $1 - username of the user who made the edit, also usable for GENDER
* $2 - title of the JavaScript page
beacon-notification-link-view-changes: Label of a notification link to the diff of the change.
beacon-notification-link-page: Label of a notification link to the page the notification is about.
beacon-special-newest: Link on Special:Notifications back to the first page (the newest notifications).
beacon-special-older: Link on Special:Notifications to the next page of older notifications.
beacon-special-nav-label: Aria label for the paging links on Special:Notifications.
